name: @projexlight/branding
summary: Per-tenant branding primitives — logo URL, color palette, email-template header/footer overrides. White-label customers register their kit once; sdk-notification + admin portals + customer-facing emails consume it uniformly.

events.name: branding.kit.published.v1
events.description: Tenant published / updated their branding kit.

hooks.name: publishKit
hooks.description: Publish or update a tenant branding kit.

hooks.name: resolveKit
hooks.description: Resolve the active branding kit for a tenant (falls back to ProjexCloud default).

scenarios.title: Tenant publishes their branding kit
scenarios.when_to_use: First-time onboarding. Tenant uploads logo via sdk-media, sets primary color + email header HTML.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Kit row written; emits .kit.published.v1. Future emails + UI surfaces inherit the kit.

scenarios.title: Notification renderer resolves kit before send
scenarios.when_to_use: sdk-notification template renderer fetches the kit for the recipient's tenant + interpolates into the template.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Email sent with tenant logo + colors. Fallback to ProjexCloud default if no kit published.

scenarios.title: White-label admin portal renders tenant branding
scenarios.when_to_use: Reseller customer with their own brand — tenant-admin portal reads the kit on every page render.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Portal renders with the customer's brand. Multi-tenant resellers don't see each other's branding.

compliance_posture.notes: Branding kit is non-PII display data. Logo URLs stored as blob refs via sdk-media — no inline base64 storage.
